title: Retry-runway arithmetic in new comment is internally inconsistent
evidence: +# retries (3 attempts, 2/8/32s backoff, ~42s runway) absorb the cold-start
detail: Three backoff intervals (2/8/32s) imply four attempts; three total attempts see only 2+8=10s between first and last try. Either the count or the ~42s runway is wrong, weakening the cold-start absorption claim.
recommended_fix: Recheck the actual Gleam retry policy; correct the comment, and re-validate that the real retry window covers worst-case cold-start latency.
